nodes.natural_language: Show that for any real-valued function $a$ on the natural numbers such that $\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, a_i \geq 0$, if $prod_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i = 1$, then $sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i \geq n$.
